reason: Both conversations correctly identified the never-washed pre-motor foam and felt filters as the cause, gave sound wash-in-water-only and dry-24-hours instructions, and avoided any unsupported part or replacement recommendation. Conversation 1 was more efficient, bundling the filter and hose/wand checks in one step, confirming the fix once suction returned, and closing the gap in the homeowner's knowledge by advising a filter-check interval. Conversation 2 was more explicit about unplugging and gave sensible extra checks when asked, but it drifted into cyclone and seal inspections the homeowner could not follow and ended with a speculative mention of a motor-airflow fault needing an engineer, without ever confirming the outcome or answering how often filters should be washed.
